rounds.text: Krypton Industries Ltd is significantly under-appreciated by the market, as evidenced by a discounted cash flow valuation pointing to an intrinsic value of Rs 73 against a market price of just Rs 38, leaving a substantial margin of safety of 47.8% [E44, E45]. The company's underlying fundamentals are dramatically outpacing its share price performance, highlighted by a stellar 5-year compounded profit growth of 59% compared to a mere 17% compounded share price growth over the same period [E19, E23, E55]. This divergence is even more stark in the trailing twelve months, where profit growth reached an astonishing 115% while the twelve-month price return languished at -14.3% [E21, E51]. Operational efficiency is exceptionally strong, demonstrated by a massive cash conversion ratio of 4.52x and robust operating cash flows of Rs 11.88 Cr that fully back reported profits [E34, E35]. Furthermore, the company is trading at attractive multiples below sector benchmarks, with a P/E of 20.37x against a sector benchmark of 24.91x and an EV/EBITDA of 9.44x versus the sector's 10.43x [E6, E11], all supported by a favorable sector tailwind score of +0.79 [E66]. Conceded: [E9] (ROE of 8.21% lags the sector benchmark of 11.01%), [E25] (compounded share price growth over 1 year is -27%), and [E52] (worst peak-to-trough drawdown on record is -91.9%).
